Target:   n8n-io/n8n @ 80bba6f · checked 2026-11-22

Confidence: high — I read the full main licence text and the enterprise licence; only the licence was assessed, not security, maintenance or privacy.

Yes. The Sustainable Use License lets you run n8n for your own company's internal business
automation. Stay inside internal use, avoid the enterprise (".ee") features without a paid licence,
and keep the notices.

Follow-up
 • Will any of the automation be run for customers or other companies, or offered to them as a
   service?
 • Do you need enterprise-only features such as those in ".ee" code?

Why
 🟡 Licence: Internal business use is allowed; enterprise files and reselling are not.
   • Most of n8n is under the Sustainable Use License, which allows you to use it for your own
     internal business purposes, so internal automation is permitted.
     "You may use or modify the software only for your own internal business purposes or for non-commercial or" → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L32 ✔
   • Code files marked ".ee." or in ".ee" folders are not under the open terms. They need a paid n8n
     Enterprise licence to be used in production.
     "may only be used in production, if" → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE_EE.md#L7 ✔
   • You may only pass n8n to others free of charge and for non-commercial purposes. Selling it,
     hosting it for customers, or embedding it in a paid product is outside the licence.
     "You may distribute the software or provide it to others only if you do so free of charge for" → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L33 ✔

What to do next
 1. Do not use or enable enterprise (".ee.") features in production unless you buy an n8n Enterprise
   licence.
     Source: "may only be used in production, if"
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE_EE.md#L7
 2. Keep n8n for internal use only. Get a separate agreement from n8n before hosting it for
   customers or reselling it.
     Source: "You may distribute the software or provide it to others only if you do so free of
       charge…"
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L33
 3. Keep the licence notices intact, and mark any modified copies clearly.
     Source: "If you modify the software, you must include in any modified copies of the software
       a…"
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L50
 4. Have your legal team review the custom licence before rollout, especially if group companies
   will share one installation.
     Source: ""licence_spdx": "NOASSERTION""
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n
